definitions.gloss: next season (in sports, fashion or business)
definitions.explanation: The coming season, especially a sports league's next season, a fashion season or a business period. Common in sports news about contracts, transfers and team plans.

examples.japanese: {来季|らいき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{来季|らいき}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦プレー→プレー：29432_puree⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He will play for the same team next season as well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{球団|きゅうだん}→球団：16190_kyuudan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{来季|らいき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}けて→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The club announced a contract with a new manager ahead of next season.

notes:
USAGE:
A news and business word; in conversation people more often say ⟦{来|らい}→来〜：00349_rai⟧⟦シーズン→シーズン：10944_shiizun⟧. The current season is ⟦{今季|こんき}→今季：31605_konki⟧ and the last one {昨季|さっき}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {来季|らいき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧: next season's contract
- {来季|らいき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}けて→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧: ahead of next season
- {来季|らいき}⟦{以降|いこう}→以降：03999_ikou⟧: from next season on

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{来年度|らいねんど}→来年度：28221_rainendo⟧: the next fiscal or school year
- {来期|らいき}: the next (business) term, same reading; used for accounting periods
